issue_time_safety_policy: All features strictly derivable at availability_time <= issue_time. Ground truth ERA5 reanalysis and future verification observations strictly forbidden.

features.name: ensemble_std
features.description: Standard deviation across all 31 GEFS ensemble members at forecast valid_time

features.name: ensemble_range
features.description: Difference between maximum and minimum ensemble member forecast values (ensemble_max - ensemble_min)

features.name: ensemble_iqr
features.description: Interquartile/decile range between 90th and 10th percentiles of ensemble members (q90 - q10)

features.name: ensemble_skew_proxy
features.description: Proxy for ensemble distribution asymmetry: (mean - midpoint) / (std + eps)

features.name: ensemble_cv
features.description: Coefficient of variation: ensemble_std / (|ensemble_mean| + eps)

features.name: ensemble_spread_to_iqr_ratio
features.description: Ratio of ensemble standard deviation to ensemble IQR (tail thickness proxy)

features.name: member_count
features.description: Number of active ensemble members populated for the forecast step

features.name: has_full_ensemble
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether all 31 operational ensemble members are present

features.name: forecast_value
features.description: Deterministic control forecast value (member 0 / control run)

features.name: ensemble_mean
features.description: Arithmetic mean of all 31 ensemble member forecasts

features.name: ensemble_spread_delta_6h
features.description: 6-hour forward difference in ensemble spread along forecast lead trajectory: spread(t) - spread(t - 6h)

features.name: ensemble_spread_delta_24h
features.description: 24-hour diurnal difference in ensemble spread along forecast lead trajectory: spread(t) - spread(t - 24h)

features.name: forecast_delta_6h
features.description: 6-hour forecast rate-of-change along forecast lead trajectory: forecast(t) - forecast(t - 6h)

features.name: forecast_delta_24h
features.description: 24-hour forecast diurnal change along forecast lead trajectory: forecast(t) - forecast(t - 24h)

features.name: lead_hours
features.description: Forecast lead time in hours from issue_time (valid_time - issue_time)

features.name: lead_days
features.description: Forecast lead time in days (lead_hours / 24.0)

features.name: valid_hour
features.description: Hour of the day in UTC (0-23) for the target valid time

features.name: valid_month
features.description: Month of the year (1-12) for the target valid time

features.name: valid_dayofweek
features.description: Day of the week (0=Monday, 6=Sunday) for the target valid time

features.name: sin_hour
features.description: Sine trigonometric transformation of valid_hour: sin(2 * pi * valid_hour / 24)

features.name: cos_hour
features.description: Cosine trigonometric transformation of valid_hour: cos(2 * pi * valid_hour / 24)

features.name: sin_month
features.description: Sine trigonometric transformation of valid_month: sin(2 * pi * valid_month / 12)

features.name: cos_month
features.description: Cosine trigonometric transformation of valid_month: cos(2 * pi * valid_month / 12)

features.name: is_weekend
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether valid_time falls on Saturday or Sunday

features.name: latitude
features.description: Latitude coordinate of target grid point in degrees North

features.name: longitude
features.description: Longitude coordinate of target grid point in degrees East

target_definitions.primary_target_description: Indicator of whether forecast absolute error exceeds the conditional q95 threshold fitted on historical training data
